title: fix: accept hexadecimal values for Disassemble x86 address arguments
issueTitle: Bug report: Disassemble x86: Unable to specify hexadecimal values for code segment
why: The report does not show the correct output for a hex code segment (how the address prefix is formatted, or whether 10 should then be read as hex), and the error it quotes comes from loading a recipe link rather than from typing in the on-screen field, so there is no exact visible text to check with certainty.
